titles.title: White Calla Lily

description: A white calla lily, seen from above, sweeps across the frame. A yellow spike protrudes from its center at the bottom third of the composition. The flower's form is echoed by what appears to be crinkled paper wrapping around the bloom. The background is mostly brown but is covered by a white form in the upper lefthand corner.
title: White Calla Lily
